items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was recorded recently on an album, with Bill Brown singing and the National Czech Republic Orchestra

ctx.x: . . . and strings. That was – I wrote a piece called – to go with that – it’s called Life Cycles. It was recorded recently on an album, with Bill Brown singing and the National Czech Republic Orchestra [Czech National Symphony Orchestra] again. That’s already out.

Anyway, [I have written] close to 2,000 compositions, and I’m not going to try to go through all of them. Most of the stuff is with a publisher, either Walrus [Music Publishing] if it's jazz, or it’s with . . .
